description: Recyparcs mobiles - Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Ce jeu de données reprend les lieux et dates de passage des recyparcs mobiles sur le territoire de la Ville de Liège. Déchets acceptés Encombrants, déchets verts, bois, métaux, déchets d'équipements électriques et électroniques, films plastiques, pots de fleurs, huiles de friture et de moteur, piles et frigolite. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are propreté, recycler, environnement, Parcs à conteneurs. The portal shows 96 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
